title: The First Promise
question: In the curse on the serpent, what does God promise about the woman's seed and the enemy's defeat?
blurb: Spoken in Eden's darkest hour, the first hint of a coming Rescuer who will crush the serpent.

nodes.content: In the curse on the serpent, what does God promise about the woman's seed and the enemy's defeat?

nodes.verseText: And I will put enmity between you and the woman, and between your seed and her seed. He will crush your head, and you will strike his heel.”
But when the time had fully come, God sent His Son, born of a woman, born under the law,
The one who practices sin is of the devil, because the devil has been sinning from the very start. This is why the Son of God was revealed, to destroy the works of the devil.
The God of peace will soon crush Satan under your feet. The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you.

nodes.content: The serpent strikes the heel (a wound), but the woman's seed crushes the head (a death blow) - a costly victory, not a stalemate.

nodes.verseText: Now since the children have flesh and blood, He too shared in their humanity, so that by His death He might destroy him who holds the power of death, that is, the devil,
